The word **"doge"** (as in the meme and cryptocurrency) is pronounced like **"dohj"**—rhyming with **"odge"** or **"lodge"** but starting with a "d" sound.

- **IPA:** /doʊdʒ/
- **Phonetic spelling:** DOHJ

This pronunciation comes from the original "Doge" meme, which used the word as a misspelling of "dog" for comedic effect. The pronunciation is not the same as the historical Venetian title "Doge" (which is pronounced "DOH-zhay" or "DOH-jeh").

So, for the meme and crypto context, say it like **"dohj"**!
